title: Blindfire
description: Artillery in the dark on a scrolling map that's different every match: new lakes, rivers, forests, mountains and season. Drive your launcher and click anywhere to fire at rivals you can't see. Every landing is rated Cold to Scorching and pays more the closer it was; spend it on bigger warheads, faster reloads, radar and armor until one blast covers half the map. Land inside your own blast and you're out. Play the CPU (1–5 rivals) or up to six players online with a room code.
controls: WASD drive, click to fire, arrow keys / screen edges / right-drag / minimap to scroll, wheel to zoom, Space back to your launcher, B upgrades (1-6 buy), Esc menu, M sound. Touch: stick drives, tap the map to fire, drag to scroll, pinch to zoom.
requirements: Any modern browser. Playing a friend needs an internet connection.
